snapshot.text: Denmark has a publicly funded, largely decentralised system in which local governments deliver most care while central government sets goals and rules. Main challenges include an ageing population, rising chronic disease and an imbalance between hospitals and local services. Ida Auken took over the health portfolio…

priorities.title: Health Close to You reform
priorities.text: A reform proposed in 2024 to move care from hospitals toward local services, backed by a DKK 24 billion health fund for hospitals and health technology. Its current status is not confirmed here.

netherlands.text: Danish life science firms and the Danish Embassy in The Hague back a Dutch-Danish alliance that supports long-term health cooperation between the two countries.
